title: Extra-Hearty Split Pea Soup (Double Veggies & Potatoes)
ingredients: 2.25 cups dried green split peas, rinsed
2 quarts (8 cups) cold water or low-sodium vegetable/chicken broth
1.5 lbs meaty ham bone, diced smoked ham, or smoked turkey
4 medium Yukon Gold or Russet potatoes, peeled and cubed (extra hearty)
1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, pinch of cayenne
instructions: In a large stockpot or Dutch oven, combine the rinsed split peas, cold broth/water, ham bone (or smoked turkey), and sliced onions.
Season with salt, black pepper, and marjoram. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer gently for 60 minutes.
Remove meat from the bone and dice, returning meat to the pot. Add the double portion of chopped carrots, celery, and cubed potatoes.
Simmer uncovered on low for 35–45 minutes until the split peas break down into a thick velvety soup and the potatoes and carrots are fork-tender.
